component.name: Munajaat Maqbool
component.summary: Daily Munajaat-e-Maqbool supplications in Arabic, Urdu and English, fully offline

description.p: Munajaat Maqbool is a clean, modern, fully offline reader for Munajaat-e-Maqbool (The Accepted Whispers), the well-known collection of Qur'anic supplications compiled by Mawlana Ashraf Ali Thanawi, arranged as seven day-by-day sections from Sunday to Saturday.

Each of the 195 numbered supplications is presented in Arabic together with its Urdu translation (checked against the printed booklet) and a fresh, independent English translation made from the Arabic source, plus 200 source and instruction footnotes.

Features: trilingual text with per-language visibility, full-text search, bookmarks, adjustable text sizes and line spacing, and a dark theme that follows the system. The application works entirely offline and never uses the network. Free and open source (MIT licence) — no ads, no analytics, no accounts, no tracking.
